body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News & Press Release> PureAir(www.pure-air.co.kr) presented its cluster negative ion generator ‘EOS series’ during CES 2008, which consists ‘EOS-204’, ‘CAR EOS’ and ‘DESK EOS’.

By adopting patented ionizer made of natural ceramic material, it generates negative ion without ozone. According to the company, the EOS makes the space it is installed like a nature of a waterfall, emitting more than 100,000 negative ions within a 3-meter radius and that boost your metabolism.
Among the products of the EOS series, the EOS-204 has functions of an air clearer, employing iodine filter and antifungal filter which remove harmful gases like VOC.
